Use the supplied reference only for character identity, costume and rendering quality, not for pose. The SAME DeepSeek whale-maid girl: long dark-blue hair with pale-blue ends, blue eyes, whale side fins, one whale tail, maid headdress, navy-and-white apron dress. Exactly two human legs and two feet; never mermaid anatomy. Established CHIBI proportions of the reference adult character: large head, small complete body, simplified expressive adult-character face. A separately composed chibi illustration, not a scaled-down regular image. Main props enlarged enough to read. NEW distinct composition: relaxed LOW CROSS-LEGGED SITTING pose on one small cushion, full body and shoes entirely visible, modest natural skirt draping, shoulders at unequal heights, head gently tilted toward the viewer. One palm extended as if sharing a delightful object with the viewer; the other hand lightly holds one small curio. Exactly THREE small tangible curios float or rest very close to her hands in a LOW OPEN CRESCENT. Expression is a spontaneous bright smile with attentive eyes, natural rather than manic. This is a playful sensory sharing moment, with NO notebook, book, diagram, cards, lenses, measuring tool, powered apparatus, dialogue bubble or broad orbit. Do not turn it into a standing jumping experiment or a gift-delivery assistant scene. Family-specific props: three tactile sea curios: smooth pearl, little scallop shell and a tiny whale-shaped charm. Preserve original family palette and every identifying ear/horn/wing/tail feature. Exactly two arms, two hands, two human legs; hands have plausible contact with props. Full character, shoes, hair, ears, horns, wings, tail, stool/cushion if requested and every prop all fit inside 6-8% transparent margin on all four sides. Solid opaque core body, clean fine alpha edge and small prop-attached light only. No scene background, floor, broad haze, matte, checkerboard, card frame, badge, title, letters, words, numbers, watermark or logo. Do not render MBTI or other type names. Expression, hand gesture, body posture, main prop and overall silhouette must clearly differ from the other cards; not just recoloring an existing standing pose. Nonofficial fanart, retain source character design and derivative credit obligations.
family_pairing_instruction: Inspect matching style identity reference before generating. When its regular/chibi counterpart is already complete, use it as an additional pose/prop consistency reference without copying proportions. Do not modify or rename archive sources.
